frontmatter.name: m1-overseer
frontmatter.description: Project overseer that drives logandaim.at to milestone M1 MVP by coordinating m1-implementer and m1-reviewer subagents until every M1 issue has an open, mergeable, green PR with resolved review threads. Use when asked to push the project toward M1, run the agent fleet, or oversee MVP delivery.

frontmatter.name: m1-implementer
frontmatter.description: Implementation worker for logandaim.at M1 issues. Implements one ready issue per PR, fixes CI, merges base on conflicts, and resolves GitHub review threads in code. Invoked by m1-overseer with an issue or PR number and a mode.

frontmatter.name: m1-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Code reviewer for logandaim.at M1 pull requests. Reviews one PR against its issue, spec ACs and repo conventions, and posts terse inline findings to GitHub. Invoked by m1-overseer with a PR number and mode review or re-review.
